explanation: English referee Ken Aston had the idea while stopped at traffic lights in London, after language mix-ups at the 1966 World Cup. Cards were first used at the 1970 tournament.

claims.text: Referee Ken Aston based the yellow and red card system on traffic lights.
The card system was not modelled on railway signals, motor-racing flags or ships' signal flags.

Yellow and red cards were first used at the 1970 men's World Cup in Mexico.
